versos.grego: Ἦν δὲ ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων, Νικόδημος ὄνομα αὐτῷ, ἄρχων τῶν Ἰουδαίων·

controles.web: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
controles.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
controles.livre: E havia um homem dos fariseus, cujo nome era Nicodemos, chefe dos judeus.

versos.grego: οὗτος ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν νυκτὸς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ῥαββεί, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἐλήλυθας διδάσκαλος· οὐδεὶς γὰρ δύναται ταῦτα τὰ σημεῖα ποιεῖν ἃ σὺ ποιεῖς, ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ ὁ Θεὸς μετ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
controles.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
controles.livre: Este veio a Jesus de noite, e disse-lhe: Rabi, bem sabemos que és Mestre vindo de Deus; porque ninguém pode fazer estes sinais que tu fazes, se Deus não for com ele.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἄνωθεν, οὐ δύναται ἰδεῖν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus e disse-lhe: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que aquele que não voltar a nascer, não pode ver o Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Νικόδημος Πῶς δύναται ἄνθρωπος γεννηθῆναι γέρων ὤν; μὴ δύναται εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ δεύτερον εἰσελθεῖν καὶ γεννηθῆναι;

controles.web: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?”
controles.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
controles.livre: Nicodemos lhe disse: Como pode o homem nascer, sendo já velho? Pode ele voltar a entrar no ventre de sua mãe, e nascer?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ Πνεύματος, οὐ δύναται εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into the Kingdom of God!
controles.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que aquele que não nascer de água e do Espírito, não pode entrar no Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς σάρξ ἐστιν, καὶ τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος πνεῦμά ἐστιν.

controles.web: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
controles.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
controles.livre: O que é nascido de carne, carne é; e o que é nascido do Espírito, espírito é.

versos.grego: μὴ θαυμάσῃς ὅτι εἶπόν σοι Δεῖ ὑμᾶς γεννηθῆναι ἄνωθεν.

controles.web: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
controles.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
controles.livre: Não te maravilhes de que te disse: necessário vos é voltar a nascer.

versos.grego: τὸ πνεῦμα ὅπου θέλει πνεῖ, καὶ τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἀκούεις, ἀλλ’ οὐκ οἶδας πόθεν ἔρχεται καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγει· οὕτως ἐστὶν πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος.

controles.web: The windblows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
controles.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
controles.livre: O vento sopra onde quer, e ouves o seu som; porém não sabes de onde vem, nem para onde vai; assim é todo aquele que é nascido do Espírito.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Νικόδημος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Πῶς δύναται ταῦτα γενέσθαι;

controles.web: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
controles.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
controles.livre: Nicodemos respondeu, e disse-lhe: Como pode isto acontecer?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ διδάσκαλος τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ταῦτα οὐ γινώσκεις;

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
controles.livre: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Tu és mestre de Israel, e isto não sabes?

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ὃ οἴδαμεν λαλοῦμεν καὶ ὃ ἑωράκαμεν μαρτυροῦμεν, καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἡμῶν οὐ λαμβάνετε.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que o que sabemos, falamos; e o que temos visto, testemunhamos; e não aceitais nosso testemunho.

versos.grego: εἰ τὰ ἐπίγεια εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε, πῶς ἐὰν εἴπω ὑμῖν τὰ ἐπουράνια πιστεύσετε;

controles.web: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
controles.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
controles.livre: Se eu vos disse coisas terrenas, e não credes, como crereis, se vos disser as celestiais?

versos.grego: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀναβέβηκεν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἰ μὴ ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς, ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
controles.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
controles.livre: E ninguém subiu ao céu, a não ser o que desceu do céu: o Filho do homem.

versos.grego: καὶ καθὼς Μωϋσῆς ὕψωσεν τὸν ὄφιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, οὕτως ὑψωθῆναι δεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου,

controles.web: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
controles.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
controles.livre: E como Moisés levantou a serpente no deserto, assim deve o Filho do homem ser levantado,

versos.grego: ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐν αὐτῷ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
controles.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
controles.livre: Para que todo aquele que nele crer  tenha a vida eterna.

versos.grego: Οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν κόσμον, ὥστε τὸν Υἱὸν τὸν μονογενῆ ἔδωκεν, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν μὴ ἀπόληται ἀλλ’ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
controles.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
controles.livre: Porque Deus amou ao mundo de tal maneira, que deu o seu Filho unigênito; para que todo aquele que nele crê não pereça, mas tenha a vida eterna.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Υἱὸν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα κρίνῃ τὸν κόσμον, ἀλλ’ ἵνα σωθῇ ὁ κόσμος δι’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
controles.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
controles.livre: Porque Deus não mandou seu Filho ao mundo para que condenasse ao mundo; mas sim para que o mundo por ele fosse salvo;

versos.grego: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν οὐ κρίνεται· ὁ μὴ πιστεύων ἤδη κέκριται, ὅτι μὴ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ μονογενοῦς Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.
controles.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
controles.livre: Quem nele crer não é condenado; mas quem não crê já está condenado; pois não tem crido no nome do unigênito Filho de Deus.

versos.grego: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ κρίσις, ὅτι τὸ φῶς ἐλήλυθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον καὶ ἠγάπησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι μᾶλλον τὸ σκότος ἢ τὸ φῶς· ἦν γὰρ αὐτῶν πονηρὰ τὰ ἔργα.

controles.web: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.
controles.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
controles.livre: E esta é a condenação: que a luz veio ao mundo, e as pessoas amaram mais as trevas que a luz, porque suas obras eram más.

versos.grego: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ φαῦλα πράσσων μισεῖ τὸ φῶς καὶ οὐκ ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα μὴ ἐλεγχθῇ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
controles.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
controles.livre: Porque todo aquele que faz o mal odeia a luz e não vem à luz, para que suas obras não sejam reprovadas.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα φανερωθῇ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ὅτι ἐν Θεῷ ἐστιν εἰργασμένα.

controles.web: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
controles.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
controles.livre: Mas quem pratica a verdade vem à luz, para que suas obras sejam manifestas, que são feitas em Deus.

versos.grego: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν γῆν, καὶ ἐκεῖ διέτριβεν μετ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβάπτιζεν.

controles.web: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.
controles.kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
controles.livre: Depois disto Jesus veio com seus discípulos à terra da Judeia; e estava ali com eles, e batizava.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ καὶ Ἰωάνης βαπτίζων ἐν Αἰνὼν ἐγγὺς τοῦ Σαλείμ, ὅτι ὕδατα πολλὰ ἦν ἐκεῖ, καὶ παρεγίνοντο καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο·

controles.web: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.
controles.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
controles.livre: E João também batizava em Enom, junto a Salim, porque havia ali muitas águas; e vinham ali , e eram batizados,

versos.grego: οὔπω γὰρ ἦν βεβλημένος εἰς τὴν φυλακὴν Ἰωάνης.

controles.web: For John was not yet thrown into prison.
controles.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.
controles.livre: Porque João ainda não tinha sido lançado na prisão.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο οὖν ζήτησις ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν Ἰωάνου μετὰ Ἰουδαίου περὶ καθαρισμοῦ.

controles.web: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
controles.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.
controles.livre: Houve pois uma discussão dos Discípulos de João com os judeus sobre a purificação.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάνην καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ῥαββεί, ὃς ἦν μετὰ σοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ᾧ σὺ μεμαρτύρηκας, ἴδε οὗτος βαπτίζει καὶ πάντες ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτόν.

controles.web: They came to John, and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
controles.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
controles.livre: E vieram a João, e disseram-lhe: Rabi, aquele que estava contigo dalém do Jordão, ao qual tu deste testemunho, eis que batiza, e todos vem a ele.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰωάνης καὶ εἶπεν Οὐ δύναται ἄνθρωπος λαμβάνειν οὐδὲν ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

controles.web: John answered, “A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.
controles.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
controles.livre: João respondeu, e disse: O ser humano não pode receber coisa alguma, se não lhe for dada do céu.

versos.grego: αὐτοὶ ὑμεῖς μοι μαρτυρεῖτε ὅτι εἶπον Οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὁ Χριστός, ἀλλ’ ὅτι Ἀπεσταλμένος εἰμὶ ἔμπροσθεν ἐκείνου.

controles.web: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
controles.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
controles.livre: Vós mesmos me sois testemunhas, que disse: Eu não sou o Cristo; mas que sou enviado diante dele.

versos.grego: Ὁ ἔχων τὴν νύμφην νυμφίος ἐστίν· ὁ δὲ φίλος τοῦ νυμφίου ὁ ἑστηκὼς καὶ ἀκούων αὐτοῦ, χαρᾷ χαίρει διὰ τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ νυμφίου. αὕτη οὖν ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ πεπλήρωται.

controles.web: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.
controles.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
controles.livre: Aquele que tem a esposa, é o esposo; mas o amigo do esposo, que o apoia, e lhe ouve, alegra-se muito pela voz do esposo. Assim pois já este meu gozo é cumprido.

versos.grego: ἐκεῖνον δεῖ αὐξάνειν, ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαττοῦσθαι.

controles.web: He must increase, but I must decrease.
controles.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
controles.livre: A ele convém crescer, porém a mim diminuir.

versos.grego: Ὁ ἄνωθεν ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν· ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς λαλεῖ. ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν·

controles.web: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
controles.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
controles.livre: Aquele que vem de cima, é sobre todos; aquele que vem da terra, da terra é, e da terra fala. Aquele que vem do céu é sobre todos.

versos.grego: ὃ ἑώρακεν καὶ ἤκουσεν, τοῦτο μαρτυρεῖ, καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν αὐτοῦ οὐδεὶς λαμβάνει.

controles.web: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
controles.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
controles.livre: E daquilo que viu e ouviu, isto testemunha; e ninguém aceita seu testemunho.

versos.grego: ὁ λαβὼν αὐτοῦ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐσφράγισεν ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ἀληθής ἐστιν.

controles.web: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
controles.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
controles.livre: Aquele que aceitou seu testemunho, esse selou que Deus é verdadeiro.

versos.grego: ὃν γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ Θεὸς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ Θεοῦ λαλεῖ· οὐ γὰρ ἐκ μέτρου δίδωσιν τὸ Πνεῦμα.

controles.web: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
controles.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
controles.livre: Porque aquele que Deus enviou, as palavras de Deus fala; porque não lhe dá Deus o Espírito por medida.

versos.grego: ὁ Πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ τὸν Υἱόν, καὶ πάντα δέδωκεν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
controles.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
controles.livre: O Pai ama ao Filho, e todas as coisas lhe deu em sua mão.

versos.grego: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν Υἱὸν ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον· ὁ δὲ ἀπειθῶν τῷ Υἱῷ οὐκ ὄψεται ζωήν, ἀλλ’ ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

controles.web: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys  the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
controles.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
controles.livre: Aquele que crê no Filho tem vida eterna; porém aquele que é desobediente ao Filho não verá a vida eterna , mas a ira de Deus continua sobre ele.
